questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 16 cm and a height of 10 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height = ½ × 16 × 10 = 80 cm². Forgetting the ½ gives the wrong answer of 160.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 18 cm and a height of 6 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 18 × 6 = 54 cm². Pause and say the formula before multiplying to avoid rushing.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: In Freud's model, which part follows the pleasure principle?
questions.why: The id seeks instant pleasure with no regard for consequences, unlike the ego (reality) or superego (morals).

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a sealed container, 30g of reactants react fully. What is the mass of the products?
questions.why: In a closed system, mass is conserved, so the total mass of products equals the total mass of reactants: 30g.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What word describes a solid that suddenly appears in a reaction between two liquids?
questions.why: A precipitate is a solid that forms when two solutions react, showing a chemical change has occurred.
